database_changes.foreign_keys_added: institution_id UUID REFERENCES institutions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
unique_constraints: Partial unique index: idx_one_active_code_per_institution ON institution_access_codes(institution_id) WHERE status = 'active'

landing_page.changes: Added institution access code entry flow with rate limiting error handling; transitions to institution-branded login view; preserves 100% existing design, role cards, SVG icons, and splash animation.

super_admin_portal.features: Platform developer authentication, metric summary cards, institution registration, one-time reveal modal for 128-bit random access codes, code rotation, emergency revocation, and audit logs.

institution_admin_settings.features: Added Institution tab under dashboard tabs showing institution profile and access code status; provides Rotate Access Code button with developer permission check.

security_controls.access_code_storage: Keyed HMAC-SHA-256 hash using INSTITUTION_CODE_HMAC_KEY; zero plaintext stored
security_controls.access_code_reveal_policy: Returned strictly once upon creation or rotation
security_controls.authorization: Server-side JWT verification with active database check and role enforcement
security_controls.rate_limiting: express-rate-limit on code resolution, authentication, and management routes
security_controls.cache_control: Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private on all dashboards and APIs
security_controls.input_sanitization: JSON.stringify escaping on credential tokens, textContent DOM manipulation
security_controls.backward_compatibility: Providence College of Engineering (PCE-001) fully preserved as default fallback

deployment_requirements: Execute SQL migrations in Supabase SQL Editor: 20261105_01, 20261105_02, 20261105_03
Configure Render environment variables: INSTITUTION_CODE_HMAC_KEY, SUPER_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_USER, SUPER_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASS
Deploy backend service and verify health check
remaining_risks: Production administrators must ensure access codes are communicated through trusted internal channels and not posted publicly on open message boards.
